full_prompt_en: A square monochrome illustration depicts a young dark-haired woman turning back toward the viewer from the right side of the composition. Her shoulders angle away while her head twists over one shoulder, bringing one sharply observed eye into direct contact with the viewer. Straight glossy bangs cut across the forehead; the rest of the hair is gathered into a dense, elaborate knot of braids, flowers, ornaments, and loose strands. Her expression is steady and guarded, with a softly modeled cheek and slightly parted lips. A weathered human skull occupies the space just behind her near the center-left, its dark eye sockets and damaged lower jaw set against a field of white. A long dark sword rises diagonally from the lower-left region to the upper edge, crossing behind the head and hair arrangement. Her clothing appears richly textured, with dark floral lace, embroidered motifs, and small bright highlights along the shoulder and sleeve. Fine lines and tightly layered grayscale shading describe every surface: gleaming hair, bone fissures, patterned fabric, and decorative metalwork. The backdrop is almost empty white, so the intricate black forms appear cut out with emphatic clarity. Light is even and high key, but the rendering uses deep black masses beneath the hair and clothing to give the figure weight. The main face sits near the right edge, balanced by the skull on the left and the diagonal sword above. The image combines realistic facial modeling with densely ornamental penlike detail and an unsettling stillness; it reads as one finished illustration rather than a collage of separate fragments.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白插画描绘一名年轻黑发女子从构图右侧回头看向观众。她的肩膀斜向画外，头却扭过一侧，使一只刻画锐利的眼睛直视观者。笔直发亮的刘海横过额头，其余头发束成繁密而复杂的发髻，混有辫子、花饰、饰物和散发。她的表情沉着而戒备，脸颊塑形柔和，嘴唇微张。一颗风化的人类骷髅占据她身后靠左中央的位置，深黑眼窝和破损下颌衬在白色区域前。一把深色长刀从左下方向上斜升至画面顶部，穿过头部与发饰后方。衣着质地极丰厚，肩袖上有深色花边、刺绣图案和零星亮色高光。细线及紧密层叠的灰阶阴影刻画每种表面：发亮的头发、骨骼裂隙、花纹布料和装饰金属。背景几乎全白，使复杂的黑色形体以强烈的清晰度突出。照明均匀且明亮，但画法在头发和衣着下使用大片深黑，让人物具有重量。主要面孔靠近右边缘，由左侧骷髅和上方斜刀保持平衡。画面把真实的面部塑形、繁密如钢笔绘制的装饰细节和令人不安的静止感结合起来；它是一幅完整插画，而非分离碎片的拼贴。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome illustration builds intensity through deep ink blacks, bright white reserves, and finely controlled grayscale rendering. Smooth anatomical shading meets densely etched ornamental detail, including hair strands, lace-like pattern, weathered bone texture, and reflective hard surfaces. An almost blank backdrop sharpens the silhouette and keeps the most elaborate forms easy to read. Diagonal structural strokes counterbalance a close cropped focal form. Light is broadly even, while local contrast and layered hatching create volume. The visual language is precise, darkly ornate, and graphic, with realistic surfaces embedded in a strongly designed black-and-white arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白插画以深墨黑、明亮留白和精确控制的灰阶刻画建立强度。平滑的人体明暗塑形与密集蚀刻般的装饰细节相遇，包括发丝、花边状图案、风化骨质和反光硬质表面。几乎空白的背景使剪影更锐利，也让最复杂的形状容易辨认。斜向结构线与近景裁切的焦点形体形成平衡。光线整体均匀，局部反差和层叠排线则制造体积。视觉语言精确、暗丽且图形化，把真实的表面置入经过强烈设计的黑白结构。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman turning toward the viewer beside a skull and sword
theme_zh: 一名黑发女子在骷髅与刀剑旁回首
name: Shohei Otomo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
